title: Explicit normalized coefficient-tensor towers and their diagram predicate
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$, and a scheme $T$. Put $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$ and $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Let $Q_n$ be K-flat complexes of $B_n$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] with strict semilinear chain transitions $q_{n,m}:Q_n\to Q_m$ for $1\leq m\leq n$, satisfying identities and the cocycle law. Assume every actual reduction map $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m\to Q_m$, $x\otimes b\mapsto bq_{n,m}(x)$, is a quasi-isomorphism. No boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

Fix $m\geq1$ and, for $n\geq m$, put $K_m=[R\xrightarrow{\ell^m}R]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$, $P_{n,m}=B_n\otimes_RK_m$, $F_{n,m}=\operatorname{Cone}(P_{n,m}\to B_m)[-1]$, and $S_n=Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m$, using the coefficient augmentation and total tensor convention of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Define the reduction and coefficient-fiber tensor levels, the Koszul middle levels, the powered shifted tail, pure-tensor coordinate formulas, and the predicate recording a strict triangle, its normalized reduction, and its actual derived-limit diagonal. These are the explicit total-complex constructions of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], scalar cones of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber], and constant/limit unit of [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections].
